exclusions.description: Module aggregators and other sources that carry no SpecGate annotation declare no implementation semantics, so they are out of scope by rule and are not listed individually.

Sources that carry SpecGate annotations but declare no operation contribute no component surface of their own. Each is listed explicitly so adding an operation to one of them fails the gate until it gains a row.

replacement.feature: spec mock runtime (mock fields, multiple responses, and not-found responses)
replacement.rationale: Mocked collaborators were replaced by real annotated child operations. A parent operation calls a deterministic annotated dependency, and capture records the nested invocation as observed behavior instead of a scripted response.

replacement.feature: spec property cases and generated inputs
replacement.rationale: Generated property inputs were replaced by fixed witness inputs in ordinary tests. Captures stay byte-deterministic, and the property being witnessed is stated by the test itself.

replacement.feature: spec matcher operators (contains, approximately, set and map matchers)
replacement.rationale: Matcher operators were replaced by exact structured values compared under the fixed ctsc.strict/0.1.0 policy. Sets and maps compare without wire order, and every other value compares exactly, so no per-assertion operator vocabulary is needed.

replacement.feature: spec-declared target routing and per-case target selection
replacement.rationale: Case-level target routing was replaced by strict binding resolution plus an explicit divergence witness. The binding parser validates the component, implementation, and path shape strictly, and cross-target divergence is observed by comparing captured traces rather than by routing declarations.

replacement.rationale: Coverage of the spec surface was replaced by this matrix. Every annotated fixture source must belong to a row, every discovered component must have a row, and every declared artifact must be generated, so gaps fail the gate instead of lowering a percentage.

replacement.feature: spec run provenance and report metadata
replacement.rationale: Report provenance was replaced by the capture manifest and its digests. Each bundle records the tool, target, registry identity, and SHA-256 digests of the registry and reference trace, and bundle validation re-verifies them.
